item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po 'phrin las me ri 'khyil pa rin chen gter mdzod rgyud las smin grol dbang gi cho ga gdug pa tshar bcad
item.coloph: ces pa mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar mas snyan du brgyud nas phyis sa rta hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bzang por mi 'gyur gsang sngags grags pas rgyal mo rngu chu'i 'gram du babs pas/ yi ge pa ni mang+ga ming gis byas pa bstan dang 'gro la phan bde rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig gi smon pa dang bcas te// atha/
